who_is_it_for.name: Children
who_is_it_for.definition: Umbrella: children aged 12 and below (any child age band below also applies).

who_is_it_for.name: Infants and toddlers (0-3)
who_is_it_for.definition: Children aged 0 to 3 (infant care, early intervention, toddlers).

who_is_it_for.name: Preschool children (4-6)
who_is_it_for.definition: Children aged 4 to 6 (kindergarten, preschool).

who_is_it_for.name: Primary school children (7-12)
who_is_it_for.definition: Children aged 7 to 12 (primary school).

who_is_it_for.name: Teenagers (13-17)
who_is_it_for.definition: Adolescents aged 13 to 17 (secondary school / minors).

who_is_it_for.name: Youth
who_is_it_for.definition: Umbrella: youths aged 13 to 21.

who_is_it_for.name: Youth-at-risk
who_is_it_for.definition: Youths aged 13 to 21 at risk of offending, school dropout, or other adverse outcomes.

who_is_it_for.name: Teenagers facing pregnancy
who_is_it_for.definition: Teenagers (13-19) who are pregnant or facing an unplanned pregnancy.

who_is_it_for.name: Young adults
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons aged roughly 18-35. NCSS does not use this band; use only if the scheme says 'young adults'.

who_is_it_for.name: Adults
who_is_it_for.definition: Adults aged 22 to 59.

who_is_it_for.name: Students
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons currently enrolled in school/tertiary education. Education status, not a social-service population.

who_is_it_for.name: Families
who_is_it_for.definition: Families in general, not necessarily in distress.

who_is_it_for.name: Multi-stressed families
who_is_it_for.definition: Families facing multiple concurrent challenges across two or more needs.

who_is_it_for.name: Single parents
who_is_it_for.definition: Parents raising children on their own (divorced, widowed, unmarried, separated).

who_is_it_for.name: Women
who_is_it_for.definition: Programme restricted to women. Demographic marker.

who_is_it_for.name: Pregnant individuals in distress
who_is_it_for.definition: Pregnant persons facing crisis, unplanned pregnancy or hardship.

who_is_it_for.name: Seniors
who_is_it_for.definition: Seniors / elderly persons aged 60 and above (formerly 'Elderly').

who_is_it_for.name: Seniors with dementia
who_is_it_for.definition: Seniors / elderly persons aged 60+ diagnosed with dementia, and their care.

who_is_it_for.name: Persons with disabilities (PWDs)
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons with permanent intellectual or physical disabilities (e.g. mobility, vision, hearing, intellectual disability, cerebral palsy). Mental health conditions are NOT disabilities.

who_is_it_for.name: Persons with special needs
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons with developmental or learning needs (e.g. SPED students). Treat as disability only when the disability is permanent.

who_is_it_for.name: Persons on autism spectrum
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder.

who_is_it_for.name: Persons with chronic or terminal illnesses
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons with long-term, persistent or terminal illness requiring ongoing management (e.g. cancer, kidney failure, diabetes).

who_is_it_for.name: Persons with mental health conditions
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons diagnosed with, or severely affected by, mental health conditions (e.g. depression, schizophrenia). Recoverable, so NOT persons with disabilities.

who_is_it_for.name: Persons with substance and behavioural addictions
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons dependent on substances or compulsive behaviours (drugs, alcohol, gambling, gaming).
profile: Persons with substance and behavioural addictions

who_is_it_for.name: Individuals with gambling addiction
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons with a gambling addiction or problem gambling, and affected family.
profile: Persons with substance and behavioural addictions

who_is_it_for.name: Caregivers
who_is_it_for.definition: People providing ongoing primary care to someone with care needs from age, disability, illness or mental health condition.

who_is_it_for.name: Low income
who_is_it_for.definition: Individuals/households with insufficient income, incl. those on means-tested schemes.

who_is_it_for.name: Low income families
who_is_it_for.definition: Families with low household income.

who_is_it_for.name: Low income seniors
who_is_it_for.definition: Seniors / elderly persons aged 60+ with low income.

who_is_it_for.name: Facing financial hardship
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons or households in temporary or acute financial difficulty (job loss, debt, emergencies).

who_is_it_for.name: Unemployed
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons not in paid work, available for and seeking work.

who_is_it_for.name: Retrenched
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons who lost their job through retrenchment.

who_is_it_for.name: Homeless
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons without stable, safe accommodation, sleeping rough or moving between temporary housing.

who_is_it_for.name: Foreign domestic workers/maids
who_is_it_for.definition: Foreign domestic workers (maids) employed in Singapore households, and their employers when the scheme is for FDW matters.

who_is_it_for.name: Migrant workers/Foreign workers
who_is_it_for.definition: Foreign workers in Singapore on work passes (e.g. construction, marine).

who_is_it_for.name: Transnational families/Foreign spouses
who_is_it_for.definition: Foreign spouses of Singaporeans and cross-border families.

who_is_it_for.name: Ex-offenders
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons who completed a sentence and are reintegrating.

who_is_it_for.name: Inmates
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons currently in prison or custody.

who_is_it_for.name: Families of inmates or ex-offenders
who_is_it_for.definition: Family members of inmates or ex-offenders.

who_is_it_for.name: Victims of abuse or harassment
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons experiencing or who experienced abuse, family violence, or harassment.

who_is_it_for.name: Facing end of life
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons with a life-limiting illness nearing end of life, and their families.
who_is_it_for.note: NCSS: circumstance; review under needs, no profile parent until needs mapping arrives

who_is_it_for.name: Individuals struggling with loss
who_is_it_for.definition: Persons bereaved or grieving. Circumstance, not a population.
who_is_it_for.note: NCSS: review under needs; no profile parent

who_is_it_for.name: Malay/Muslim community
who_is_it_for.definition: Programme targeted at Malay/Muslim community. Demographic marker.

who_is_it_for.name: Indian community
who_is_it_for.definition: Programme targeted at Indian community. Demographic marker.

who_is_it_for.name: Chinese community
who_is_it_for.definition: Programme targeted at Chinese community. Demographic marker.

who_is_it_for.name: General public
who_is_it_for.definition: Open to all residents with no specific target group. Use ONLY if no other term fits.

what_it_gives.name: Counselling
what_it_gives.definition: Professional guidance by trained counsellors for personal or family issues.

what_it_gives.name: Casework
what_it_gives.definition: Coordinated assessment, planning and monitoring of a person's needs by a social worker.

what_it_gives.name: Emotional care
what_it_gives.definition: Non-clinical emotional support and companionship (listening, befriending, comfort). Skip if Counselling or Befriending services already describe the same service.
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: Mental health assessment and treatment
what_it_gives.definition: Clinical assessment/treatment of mental health conditions by clinicians.
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: Psychological support/Psychotherapy
what_it_gives.definition: Only when psychologists/psychotherapists or psychological therapy are explicitly offered. General counselling is Counselling, not this.

what_it_gives.name: Information and referral services
what_it_gives.definition: Information, guidance or referral/signposting to other services as a main function of the scheme (not just a passing mention).

what_it_gives.name: Educational programmes
what_it_gives.definition: Structured teaching of knowledge or awareness (courses, workshops, talks, parent education) as a main component. Not for counselling or support services that merely include some sessions.
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: review programmes to find actual intervention

what_it_gives.name: Learning intervention
what_it_gives.definition: Structured support that builds learning skills or academic/learning outcomes for learners (e.g. learning support, literacy/numeracy help). Use Tuition for school-subject tuition.
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: added at NCSS request; definition to confirm

what_it_gives.name: Employment assistance
what_it_gives.definition: Job search help, placement, job coaching or employer matching. Skills courses are Vocational training instead.

what_it_gives.name: Financial assistance (general)
what_it_gives.definition: Cash or in-kind help NOT tied to one stated purpose. If the funds are for a stated purpose (education, healthcare, housing, daily living, etc.) use that specific term INSTEAD of this one.

what_it_gives.name: Financial assistance for daily living expenses
Financial assistance for healthcare
what_it_gives.definition: Help paying medical bills or care.

what_it_gives.name: Financial assistance for chronic or terminal illnesses
Financial assistance for assistive technology and medical equipment
Burial and emergency assistance
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: Housing/Shelter
what_it_gives.definition: Temporary or transitional shelter or housing help.

what_it_gives.name: Respite care/Caregiver support
what_it_gives.definition: Temporary relief, training or support for caregivers, including support services offered to family caregivers alongside the main service.

what_it_gives.name: Senior sitting and caregiving services
what_it_gives.definition: Home or centre sitting/caregiving for seniors / the elderly.

what_it_gives.name: Childcare services
what_it_gives.definition: Care for children while parents are away.

what_it_gives.name: Tuition
what_it_gives.definition: Academic tuition and homework/learning coaching for school subjects.

what_it_gives.name: Enrichment programmes
what_it_gives.definition: Non-academic enrichment (arts, sports, life skills, holiday programmes) for personal growth.

what_it_gives.name: Healthcare (general/basic services)
what_it_gives.definition: General clinic and basic health services.

what_it_gives.name: Addictions treatment and rehabilitation
what_it_gives.definition: Treatment and recovery support for addictions.
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: Social and recreational activities
what_it_gives.definition: Group social, recreational, exercise, arts or outing activities for engagement and connection, when such activities are a main component.

what_it_gives.name: Bereavement support
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: End-of-life care
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: Retirement and financial planning assistance
what_it_gives.note: NCSS: no match, programme review pending

what_it_gives.name: Benefits and perks for PWDs (transport, discounts, facilities)
Home retrofitting
what_it_gives.definition: Home modifications, repairs and upgrades (e.g. grab bars, ramps, minor repairs).

what_it_gives.name: Assistive technology
what_it_gives.definition: Assistive devices and equipment (e.g. mobility aids, hearing aids, wheelchairs).
what_it_gives.note: our assumption; NCSS has no match

scheme_type.name: Family and Parenting Support
scheme_type.definition: Parenting, marriage, family relationship and family life support.

scheme_type.name: Disability Support
scheme_type.definition: Support for persons with disabilities: mobility, daily living, centre/home-based care, accessibility.

scheme_type.name: Active Ageing and Social Activities
scheme_type.definition: Social, recreational and active-ageing activities that keep seniors (or others) engaged and connected.

scheme_type.name: Child and Youth Services
scheme_type.definition: Care, protection, development and support programmes for children and youths (residential care, youth centres, mentoring, child welfare).

scheme_type.name: Caregiver Support
scheme_type.definition: Training, respite and support for caregivers.

scheme_type.name: Healthcare
scheme_type.definition: Treatment and prevention of physical health issues.

scheme_type.name: Mental Health
scheme_type.definition: Emotional support and treatment for mental health.

scheme_type.name: Mental Health Rehabilitation
scheme_type.definition: Recovery and rehabilitation for mental health.

scheme_type.name: Seniors Housing and Home Improvement
scheme_type.definition: Home upgrades/repairs for seniors / the elderly.

scheme_type.name: Loss of Breadwinner Support
scheme_type.definition: Support after loss of family income earner.
